subject.title: fix(qqbot): add timeout to speech transcription requests

question: Should QQBot STT adopt this PR's 30-second default request deadline for existing users, or should the fallback be tuned before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and tested, but selecting the fallback timeout intentionally changes behavior for slow STT providers that previously had no per-request deadline.

options.title: Accept the 30-second default
options.body: Merge this path as-is and note that slow self-hosted STT endpoints can raise existing provider or media `timeoutSeconds`.

options.title: Tune the fallback first
options.body: Change only the fallback timeout constant and matching expectations if maintainers want a less aggressive STT baseline.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader HTTP-timeout campaign settles one shared default policy for channel/plugin request deadlines.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second default
recommendation.body: Merge this path as-is and note that slow self-hosted STT endpoints can raise existing provider or media `timeoutSeconds`.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp is the strongest QQBot feature-history signal for a channel-specific runtime default decision.
